kind: Reconstructed sprites, not recovered original assets

prompts.cups:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent trophy/reward sprite atlas for the HALL OF FAME and mission rewards in Baseball Heroes.
The reference is a screenshot of the original Flash game's Hall of Fame. Use the four small header cups and dark locked silhouettes as precise shape/material reference; do NOT reproduce the screenshot or interface.
Create one evenly spaced 3-column by 2-row atlas containing exactly six isolated symbols, all fully inside their cells with generous transparent padding. Row 1: bronze/copper trophy; polished silver trophy; polished gold trophy. Row 2: bright cyan/diamond glass trophy; a dark charcoal locked trophy silhouette; one golden five-point skill-point star.
The four unlocked cups all have the same original silhouette: a low wide round bowl, two small looping handles, a short narrow stem, circular stepped pedestal. Smooth curved metal with narrow strong white reflected highlights on left and darker shaded sides. Match the original's compact hand-illustrated Flash treatment and relative bowl-to-stem proportions; do not make a tall modern sports trophy. Cyan trophy is luminous aqua material but same cup shape, no giant crystal attached. Locked version is a clean almost-flat dark charcoal silhouette of that same cup, as visible in the reference. Skill point is a single compact golden five-point star with beveled facets and a dark outline, NO stand, no plinth, no lettering.
No text, numbers, labels, panels, circles behind the trophies, confetti or UI. No checkerboard or colored background. True transparent background. Crisp small game artwork, no photorealism. All six symbols centered and separated. These are faithful reconstructions, not recovered original assets.
prompts.alphaRefinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this six-cell trophy atlas. Keep all SIX trophy/star drawings, their exact shapes, sizes, materials, colors, cell positions and grid arrangement. Remove ALL colored atmospheric glow, haze and gradient wash surrounding or behind every symbol. Outside the hard outline of each cup, the locked cup and the star, the alpha must be exactly zero. Each trophy body and star must be fully opaque with anti-aliased edges; empty space between symbols and around the outside must be genuinely transparent. In particular remove cyan/brown/grey/gold clouds around the symbols, and remove any shadow cast outside the actual base. The locked charcoal cup stays a solid opaque dark silhouette, not a translucent hole. Do not change the artwork inside silhouettes, do not introduce a checkerboard or fill with black. One production transparent 3 by 2 sprite atlas, no added text.
prompts.missionBanner:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: ONE transparent illustrated game result banner.
Use the top MISSION COMPLETE! lettering of the supplied original Baseball Heroes screenshot as the reference. Recreate ONLY that two-line banner as a clean isolated sprite, no panel, no characters, no interface and no other words. Exact text: small top line "MISSION" and large bottom line "COMPLETE!". Spelling and exclamation mark must be exact.
Match the reference's bold playful sports Flash lettering: uppercase condensed heavy italic block letters, slightly rising baseline. MISSION is light cyan fading to deep blue with dark navy outline and a short hard shadow. COMPLETE! is pale yellow along the top fading to rich golden orange at the bottom, thick dark brown outline, thin pale edge highlight and a short offset dark shadow. A narrow sweeping dark reddish-brown speed stroke under and to the right of COMPLETE!, as in the original. Compact energetic composition that reads at 315 pixels wide. No photorealistic metal, no bevel extruded so thick that the letters become unreadable.
Keep whole word edges and motion stroke within the canvas with generous transparent padding. Genuinely transparent outside the letters and attached swoosh; no atmospheric glow, colored background, checkerboard, card or rectangular border. Output one banner, width-to-height roughly 4.3:1, no alternate versions.

processing: Selected generated PNGs copied unchanged. CPU frame copies in the game; no Python image edits.
